meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可通过 CDP 协议控制你本机的 Chrome,复用已有登录状态,完成打开网页、读取页面文字、提取登录令牌等浏览器自动化操作。
howto.when: 当你说出“浏览器操作”“CDP”“复用登录态”等关键词,或要求控制 Chrome 浏览器时触发。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 example.com 并读取页面文字
say.note: 会先探测 Chrome,必要时征得同意再启动。

say.text: 从浏览器提取登录 token 和 cookie
在已打开的页面里输入文字并点击按钮
say.note: 会先用快照定位交互元素再操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control your local Chrome via CDP, reuse existing login sessions, and perform browser automation such as opening pages, reading text, and extracting auth tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'browser operation', 'CDP', 'reuse login session', or ask to control Chrome via CDP.

say_en.text: Open example.com via CDP and read the page text.
say_en.note: Checks Chrome first, may ask for consent to launch.

say_en.text: Extract the login token and cookies from the browser.
say_en.note: Runs JavaScript to read localStorage and cookies.

say_en.text: Type text and click a button on the open page.
say_en.note: Locates interactive elements with a snapshot first.
